hypothesis: The remaining failures cluster on two coupled fetch/memory-control defects that were not addressed by the earlier capability-bit, port-binding, or BP-update-plumbing patches. First, if_stage computes its next PC from PC+4 unconditionally instead of consuming the branch_predictor outputs (bp_pred_taken/bp_pred_target/bp_btb_hit): the predictor may now be trained/updated (attempt 3), but because IF never redirects fetch to the predicted target and never carries the true predicted next PC into id_ex_pred_next_pc, the resolved next PC always mismatches the carried PC+4, so every taken branch resolves as a mispredict (predictor_training shows 64 mispredicts = 64 branches). Second, the external-memory wait path does not hold request signals stable nor exploit the wait: when a load is stalled waiting for slow external dmem (dmem_ready low), the pipeline fully stalls rather than letting an independent younger ALU instruction issue/execute, so no genuine OoO overlap occurs during the load-wait window (the observed ooo_bypass=449 pulses come from ordinary EX/MEM forwarding, not load-wait overlap), and the front-end keeps advancing/reissuing imem_addr while an imem request is still outstanding (imem_valid=1, imem_ready=0), producing the 'I-memory request changed before ready' protocol violation. Root mechanism: fetch-control (prediction consumption + imem-ready gating) and dmem-wait overlap control are implemented incorrectly in if_stage/top, so the predictor is useless, imem handshake
constraints: Top-level port names and widths in module rv32i5 must remain exactly as frozen in §A; do not rename or redeclare ports.
imem_addr must be 0 and imem_addr[1:0]==00 during reset and before first fetch; imem_addr[1:0]==00 every running cycle.
Once a request is issued (imem_valid=1 / dmem_valid=1), hold its addr/we/be/wdata stable until the corresponding ready is observed; never change imem_addr while imem_valid=1 and imem_ready=0.
IF must actually redirect fetch using bp_pred_taken/bp_pred_target and carry the resulting predicted next PC into id_ex_pred_next_pc; do not fall back to PC+4 as the prediction.
Branch predictor updates still come from the single authoritative committed-resolution event (branch_predictor.bp_update_*), with squashed younger control transfers excluded; preserve that wiring.

dbg_ooo_issue/dbg_ooo_bypass must be driven only by genuine younger-instruction issue/bypass that occurs concurrently with an older load waiting on external memory (dmem_ready low), not from ordinary EX/MEM forwarding, and never hardcoded.
Reset is synchronous active-low; dmem_valid must be 0 during reset; only WB may set halted/exit_code, and only for a committed ECALL.
JALR target = (rs1 + imm) & 32'hffff_fffe; branches/JAL/JALR resolved in EX flushing two younger entries on taken/mispredict.
dbg_features must remain a constant independent of rst_n; no test-name or address-based event gating.
Keep Icarus-safe coding: no variable part-selects, break/continue, array-slice assignment, or constant-index array writes in always blocks.
